notes: New: Play Coach. Play the computer at your level with your coach beside you: comments on every move, warnings about threats, hints in three steps, and takebacks when you blunder.
Play Coach: your moves get Game Review icons (Brilliant, Best, Excellent, Mistake, Blunder…) on the board and in the move list.
Play Coach games are saved: continue an unfinished game later, and find finished games (Review, PGN) in Play Coach and My reviews. They're part of your backup too.
Puzzles: clearer message when your rating doesn't change (Lichess only rates the first try; an expired Lichess login is now explained).
Your progress is backed up automatically (plan, streak, Memory, puzzles, profile). After a reinstall, enter your restore code in the setup and everything comes back.
The backup is encrypted on your computer and only holds training data: never your Lichess, chess.com or Chessable login.
Cleaner header: Today's plan sits in the top bar, and Board, Settings, Shortcuts and Feedback are in one ☰ menu.
A new look across the whole hub, matched to chess.com: the same colours, buttons, cards and page titles on every tab, in dark and light.
Today's plan: each step shows an icon for its type and reads like a chess.com list.
Board coordinates sit inside the squares like on chess.com.
Chessable gets the whole page, and your study time there counts for Today's plan.
Plan bar: never shown twice, and never stretched over Chessable.
Restore code: a Paste button (password managers can't fill fields on add-on pages).
After an update, an already-open Free Hub says it needs a reload (before, it silently stopped saving, so puzzle ratings didn't update).
